stories.title: Israel's president taps rival Gadi Eisenkot to form the next government
stories.summary: Israeli President Isaac Herzog gave opposition candidate Gadi Eisenkot the first chance to form a governing coalition after October's deadlocked election, a major setback for Benjamin Netanyahu. Eisenkot, a former military chief, leads a bloc seeking to oust Israel's longest-serving premier.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV wraps Uruguay visit and heads to Milei's Argentina
stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV closed out the Uruguay leg of his South American tour and traveled to Argentina, the most politically fraught stop, where austerity from libertarian President Javier Milei has strained relations with the Catholic Church.

stories.title: Poland mourns Krakow mass killing as attacker said to hold far-right views
stories.summary: Poland began two days of national mourning after a 24-year-old with far-right views drove into Krakow's Main Square and opened fire, killing six and wounding 15, with three more bodies found at his family home.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia intercepts missiles; Aramco building damaged in Riyadh
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia intercepted incoming missiles targeting the capital on Sunday, with falling debris damaging an Aramco building in Riyadh's financial district; no casualties were reported and no group immediately claimed the attack.

stories.title: OpenCode launches Browse to let AI agents drive your real browser
stories.summary: OpenCode released Browse, an MCP server and Chromium extension that lets coding agents operate your actual browser with existing tabs, logins and extensions, handing control back to you for logins, 2FA or payments.

stories.title: Apiiro: Claude Code leaked secrets in 1,122 public GitHub repos
stories.summary: Security firm Apiiro found 1,122 public copies of Claude Code's settings file containing 1,379 secrets, including database passwords and AWS keys, exposed when users chose 'don't ask again' to auto-approve commands.

stories.title: Ricursive releases Ripple-65B, an open-weight coding model under Apache 2.0
stories.summary: Ricursive Intelligence released Ripple-65B Preview, a 65B-parameter dense model trained on 12T tokens that scores 80.52 on TerminalBench 2.1, beating much larger US open-weight models on agentic coding tasks.

stories.title: Anthropic pushes ahead with pre-Thanksgiving IPO at lower valuation
stories.summary: Anthropic is pressing ahead with an IPO before Thanksgiving at a $1.25-$1.75 trillion valuation, aiming to raise $80-$100 billion, below the $2 trillion some investors had hoped for amid a tech selloff.

stories.title: Saints QB Tyler Shough sizes up Browns' 'dynamic' defense
stories.summary: Ahead of Sunday's game in New Orleans, Saints quarterback Tyler Shough said he's wary of a Browns defense that will face a Saints offense that has turned the ball over the sixth-most times in the NFL this season.

stories.title: What we learned from Ohio State's 41-28 loss to Oregon
stories.summary: Ohio State's 41-28 home loss to Oregon marked the first time since 2011 the Buckeyes have dropped three games and back-to-back contests before Thanksgiving, all but ending their College Football Playoff hopes.

stories.title: Ohio State collapses once more in 41-28 loss to Oregon
stories.summary: For the third time this season the Buckeyes collapsed under their own mistakes, falling 41-28 to Oregon in Ohio Stadium after jumping out to a 14-0 lead.

stories.title: Oregon routs Ohio State 41-28, all but ending Buckeyes' season goals
stories.summary: Ohio State led 14-0 before being dominated by a desperate three-loss Oregon team in a 41-28 loss that effectively ends the Buckeyes' major goals for the season.

stories.title: 1 winner and 5 losers from Ohio State's loss to Oregon
stories.summary: Ohio State dropped back-to-back games, this one at home to Oregon, in a loss the Buckeyes had to avoid to keep the College Football Playoff within reach, and it all but ends their chances.

stories.title: Three Ohio counties to watch in the Senate and governor's races
stories.summary: Ohio's closely contested Senate and governor's races could hinge on three counties that will test whether Democrats regain ground in former strongholds while Republicans narrow advantages in growing suburbs.

stories.title: U.S. Supreme Court to review home-distilling ban an Ohio man is fighting
stories.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court agreed to hear a challenge to the federal ban on home distilling brought by an Ohio man, a case that could affect hobby distillers across the country.

stories.title: Sunday Briefing: Inside the Ohio governor's race
stories.summary: NBC4's Sunday briefing breaks down the Ohio governor's race as Election Day nears, laying out the candidates and stakes in one of the state's top contests.

stories.title: Regional quarterfinals set for Ohio high school football playoffs
stories.summary: The second round of the Ohio high school football playoffs is set, with regional quarterfinal matchups locked in across central Ohio as teams chase a state title.
